title: P0.79: Security preflight human-assist binding
description: Convert browser_security_verification preflight blocks into an active incident with a concrete visual/human-assist action instead of a generic route-blocked response.
reason: Live audit showed the permission loop was resolved, but the next run stopped on a stale or unbound browser_security_verification block. The user then wrote 'permito observar ChatGPT', but no observation checkpoint was pending and the message fell into a generic follow-up path.
next_action: Live Windows proof: ask 'has una consulta en ChatGPT: responde solo S si entiendes'. If security_verification blocks preflight, IABV must show the four-line human-assist message, create an active incident, and handle 'permito observar ChatGPT' as a window/help action instead of local chat.
resume_hint: P0.79 adds _is_security_verification_preflight_block(), maps security preflight to terminal_state blocked_by_security_verification, stores external_consultation metadata, creates ActiveIncidentFrame, and binds 'permito/autorizo observar ChatGPT' to show_problem_window/human-assist actions.

metadata.root_cause: Security verification from WorldModel/tool history was treated as final governance block without creating an active incident or a target-window action. Follow-up permission phrases had no pending permission gate to resolve.
evidence: runtime_audit showed observation permission granted, then preflight stopped on browser_security_verification
UI response said route was blocked before launch instead of offering a concrete visual action
follow-up 'permito observar ChatGPT' was classified as no actionable incident
